_about: 3-25 (level24b), wave 4a round 1: won on tick 332 (win_by 345, slack 13) with two shots, no death and no knight (the level has none). The door's card reads medal 2 (2 portals, 5,312 ms; two of the level's three crystals, so no gold) and no achievement unlocks. Built on the world in the original's time base, the player's capsule, the portal tap's tap-time ray (R23) and the reflector's catch and leg (G9).

THE LEVEL: he starts on the left block (x 0..128, top y 80) and cannot jump. The yellow key hangs at (150, 128) beside the block's end, above the shock ring of shock_agent_2023 (centre (150, 206), areaRadius 60: it kills a player whose centre comes within 60 units, from centre y 146 at x 150). Falling off the block's end takes the key (tick 158, centre y 108) and kills him four ticks later (his centre is at y 156.9 on 162, 49 from the ring's centre). The keyhole (332, 108), the crystals (288, 80) and (288, 48) and the way on to the door are on the pocket platform (x 256..384, top y 128), shut at its right by door_locked_ent_2060 (x 353..383). So he must take the key, be out of the ring within three ticks, and be in the pocket.

THE WAY (reflect_agent_ent_2067 at (240, 122), plane vertical, is the level's own tool): a portal B in the pocket and a portal A under the key, in the ring, for him to fall into; a portal is entered by body overlap and gives back his fall turned upward (transit.json 'invert', a character's velocity times (1, -1)). A cannot be shot straight: from the block's edge the block's own corner (128, 80) hides every point under y 122 beside x 148. So the second shot goes to the reflector: the tap (225.5, 103) from the player standing at (119.6, 62.4) is 23.9 from it, the shot is caught on 119 and its leg starts at the reflector's centre and is the tap's offset from the shooter mirrored in x (G9, shot.json), so portal A opens at (134.1, 162.6). The walk: hold right 1-34 (he stands at x 119.6, the block's edge; 35 and 36 stand him on the bevel at 122.0 and 124.4, 37 drops him); tap 36 at (292, 92): B placed on 85 (49 ticks of flight, so the next tap waits for it); tap 92 at (225.5, 103): reflected on 119, A placed on 147; hold right from 146: off the block's end on 147, the key on 158, in A on 161 (centre y 143; 162 would be the ring's), out of B at (292, 92.7) with v -700, both pocket crystals on the way up (162, 163), apex y 25.5 (head 7 under the ceiling), landed on the platform on 187, right to the keyhole: the key's fly-in (key_unlocked 237) and the keyhole's fade take until 287 (the door is gone), then off the platform's right end onto the door's platform (landed 320) and the door on 332. The player is never outside the camera's view.

THE MARGINS and what it stands on (each window moves one input, the others fixed; out/parity/program/R4/r1_3-25/window.py): tap 1 on ticks 25-44, tap 2 on 84-106 (83 is refused: the first shot is still in flight), the second walk's start 132-160, the first walk's end 32-36, aims of +-4 units and more (B x 280-304, y 80-100; A x 215.5-230.5 at y 103, y 94-108 at x 225.5). The hop is the level's knife, in its own geometry: entry on the key's tick + 3, the last before the ring kills (key 158, entry 161, death would be 162). A's place decides it: the winning taps of the second shot lie between a left and top cliff (the shot is not caught: no sampled position within 32 units of the reflector, so A opens at the tap itself and he dies) and a right and low cliff (A too far left or too low: entry on 162, death). The point is the band's middle, 4 units from either cliff; a delay-2 point exists, (226.5, 95.5) enters on 160, but it is 1.5 units from the catch cliff, so the plateau was taken. Leans on rules no clip shows: the reflected leg and the catch within 32 units (G9-4, R3c-10: no reflected shot is filmed), the player's fall velocity into a portal turned upward (decoded), and the ring's 60 against the capsule's centre point. No DEV flag, PutPlayer or skipped tick.
